WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
l AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.gross_amount, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at, w.dispatch_date, s.store_id, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    AND w.dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-29' AND DATE '2024-10-27'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS orders,
  SUM(gross_amount) AS gross, SUM(net_amount) AS net, MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS min_etl, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS max_etl
FROM l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.dispatch_date
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS ctl_net_before, SUM(r.returns_net) AS ctl_returns, SUM(r.receipts) AS receipts
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=900 AND r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-29' AND DATE '2024-10-27'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH o AS (
  SELECT o.web_order_id, o.status, o.order_total_gross, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS od
  FROM fact_web_order o
  WHERE (o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NOT NULL AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-29' AND DATE '2024-10-27')
     OR (CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-29' AND DATE '2024-10-27')
),
ls AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS g, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS testlines, MIN(s.store_id) AS mn, MAX(s.store_id) AS mx
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM o) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(CASE WHEN ls.receipt_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ls.receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND ABS(ls.g-o.order_total_gross)>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mismatch,
  SUM(COALESCE(ls.testlines,0)) AS test_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN ls.mn<>900 OR ls.mx<>900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non900,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.dd IS NOT NULL AND o.dd<>o.od THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dispatch_ne_order_date
FROM o LEFT JOIN ls ON ls.receipt_id=o.web_order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.category <> 'ZZ Test' THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS web_sales_incl_vat,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS test_gross_excluded
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id = 900
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
